name: abl_module1_no_subjective
_why: Role-awareness (Module-1) ablation, matched to the method: same scaled anneal, same decoupled selection. Disclosed asymmetry: removing the subjective module deletes the per-regime value heads, so --value_hard_select is necessarily absent (arms.py:225). This is the headline ablation.

name: gen_method_holdout
_why: Generalization, method arm. Trains on (0,1,2), zero-shot on (3,4). g4 tests an unseen own-row VALUE, g3 an unseen COMBINATION -- report them separately, never as one held-out score.

name: abl_search_qtarget
_why: Search-module ablation: policy target q_softmax instead of the method's default visit-count. The visit-count cell needs NO retraining (the method of record already is visit-count) and marginal_visit_count is a proven no-op, so this is the informative target-axis cell.

name: abl_search_cover
_why: Search-module ablation: star root-cover enumeration, target stays visit-count. Re-selection is required regardless of prior results -- these arms were originally chosen on g1 NashConv, and g1 no longer exists.

name: abl_search_margvisit
_why: Search-module ablation: marginal_visit_count. Added at user request 2026-08-10. EXPECTED: no difference -- it is provably the same estimator as the method's own visit target (the factorized head makes them two reassociations of one sum; test_marginal_visit_equals_visit_loss_exactly pins the shipped code path). Read it as a NULL CONTROL: it bounds how much of any ablation gap is seed noise. It cannot show the targets differ -- with n=1 and within-run sd ~8, a numerically identical target can still land several points away.

name: gen_mamba_holdout
_why: Generalization comparison: strongest baseline on the same holdout partition. Without it the method's zero-shot number has nothing to be compared against.

name: gen_happo_holdout
_why: Generalization comparison: cheapest baseline (~0.7h), model-free reference point.

name: gen_m3w_holdout
_why: Generalization comparison: the other search-based, world-model baseline.

name: gen_mbom_holdout
_why: Generalization comparison: opponent-modelling baseline. Last in the queue -- per-role metrics only, it is excluded from NashConv on cost grounds.

name: abl_search_mctsfix
_why: Search-module ablation: both root-cover AND q_softmax. Lowest priority -- it is the interaction cell, only interpretable once the two single-factor cells above are in.
